meta.name: DUMMIES story: the Test City, tile by tile
meta.status: Narrative A, Certified, under the lore refinement of GDD Edit 95 (user-decided, 29 October): Dummy Corporation narrates; Farsight, the publisher, is named only in the Credits. Edit 98: tales 15 to 20 words; goals. Text from style run 20261029-205717-v83 on Style Guide V2; gameplay fields as story.json (edit93)
sources: GDD Edit 95: lore refinement, Dummy Corporation
rules: Numbers live in the registry: tasks and gifts name parameter IDs, never values.
A task tests the hit that writes the chassis off (the fatal hit).
Tile names are column-row, as in the game: A1 is the top-left tile.
Each tile's write-offs are story.writeOffs.<district>.<tile> in the registry (Edit 82).

Edit 93: introduce, then test. A part arrives on the tile whose brief first needs it; no brief needs a part not yet issued. Monument: Battery 1 B1 (dash), Hands 1 A2 (cone), Legs 1 B3 (jump). Parkland: Arms 1 C1 (push), Legs 2 A3 (jump), Hands 2 A2 (cone), Arms 2 A1 (push), Battery 2 B2 (combo). Waterfront: Legs 3 B1 (jump), Arms 3 B3 (push), Battery 3 B2 (combo).
A gift rides in on the drone that carries the dummy into its tile (Edit 84). Arcade sells every part for credits; its chassis ships with Battery 1 (Edit 91).
Each tile's traffic is story.traffic.<district>.<tile> in the registry, on the tile and its neighbours (Edit 85).
Edit 92: Narrative A, Certified. Act I Monument (Induction), Act II Parkland (Opening Day), Act III Waterfront (Customs).

Edit 95: Dummy Corporation narrates: deadpan and inspirational, few adjectives, no exclamation marks. Every text at most two sentences and 20 words (style.v2.text.maxSentences, style.v2.text.maxWords). Farsight is named only in the Credits.
Edit 98: a tale runs 15 to 20 words; a brief is the level's goal, imperative; the user's own lines (A1's tale, the any goal) are canon.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: Walk into the path of the incoming vehicles. Time your approach, and choose your angle carefully. Bonus points for combinations and lethal hits.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Dash into a car. The final hit must be the dash.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Drop onto a car from above. The final hit must be that drop.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Jump into a car. The jump must be the final hit.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Climb to a raised road. The final hit must land up there, not on the street.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Place a cone. The final hit must come from a car reacting to it.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Push off one car. The final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Let one car throw you into another. Take the final hit while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Walk or stand in the traffic. A car must deliver the final hit while you are not dashing.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Chain your hits into a combo. The final hit must be link {n} or later.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Step in front of the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

districts.name: Monument
districts.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.

A1.title: The welcome wall
A1.tale: Fresh off the factory floor, you're ready to do some damage to yourself. Make your engineers proud.

B1.title: The podium bridge
B1.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash into a colleague.

C1.title: The LED drum
C1.tale: The LED drum lights each bend. Step off the high road onto a car: gravity is company policy.

C2.title: The portal tower
C2.tale: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.

B2.title: The monument
B2.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand near it until a colleague finds you.

A2.title: The neon shops
A2.tale: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.

A3.title: The stacked cubes
A3.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Build the same way: one hit, then another, quickly.

B3.title: The LED canyon
B3.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a car between them.

C3.title: The LED gateway
C3.tale: The gateway thanked the car that wrote you off for driving safely. Let one colleague throw you into the next.

districts.name: Parkland
districts.intro: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.

C1.title: The lantern pavilion
C1.tale: The lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit for clients. With Arms 1, push off one car into the next.

C2.title: The amphitheatre
C2.tale: Our board watches opening day from these terraces. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.

C3.title: The arch and the roundabout
C3.tale: The arch is the Expo's gate; visitors circle the roundabout once. You go faster: chain hits before each is forgotten.

B3.title: The obelisk court
B3.tale: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake. Police escort a school party here on opening day; test them first.

A3.title: The belvedere
A3.tale: A wedding faces the traffic from the belvedere. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car, so no guest does.

A2.title: The dome by the canal
A2.tale: The dome is the Expo's showroom; you are the exhibit. Hands 2 is fitted: bait a car with a cone.

A1.title: The reservoir terraces
A1.tale: The gardener's pools need cars that stop. Teach them with Arms 2: push off one car into the next.

B1.title: The cascade
B1.tale: The cascade was built to drown out the traffic. The traffic got louder; take your hit up on the highway.

B2.title: The ring over the pools
B2.tale: The board watches the ring over the pools. Battery 2 is fitted: chain your hits.

districts.name: Waterfront
districts.intro: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

A1.title: The west portal
A1.tale: The bus carries engineers through the west portal to the bridge. It never misses; take its hit.

B1.title: The tunnel portal
B1.tale: Cars go into the tunnel under the hill, and data comes back. Legs 3 is fitted: leap into one.

C1.title: The east portal
C1.tale: The east portal faces away from its twin. Police here check papers; your Certification needs their fleet on record.

C2.title: The east beach terrace
C2.tale: The east beach terrace served tourists, then sensors. Drop from its rail onto a car; ships wait for the Certified.

C3.title: The east customs post
C3.tale: The pier tower logs all that floats: containers, ducks, one dummy. Be thrown into a car to earn your entry.

B3.title: The stilt houses
B3.tale: The stilt houses keep Chassis 0 behind glass. Arms 3 is fitted; push off a car and show it progress.

A3.title: The west customs post
A3.tale: The west tower keeps the customs log. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION: honour it on the raised road.

A2.title: The west beach terrace
A2.tale: Sand from three provinces lies under the west beach terrace. Place a cone; one more clean reading before the ceremony.

B2.title: The circus
B2.tale: The circus monument, cast from your written-off chassis, reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS). Battery 3 is fitted; chain your hits.
